chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'but do not give them a promise in secret'. He said: 'The man says,
unless you speak to them in a goodly manner
and the goodly word is the hint of proposal in its proper aspect and its lawfulness, and do not confirm the marriage tie until the book fulfills its term.

key_terms.الْكِتَابُ: The book (referring to the waiting period duration)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between secret promise and finalizing marriage during the waiting period?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that 'promising in secret' refers to subtle, indirect proposals of marriage (takhalluf) rather than direct declarations, distinguishing it from the prohibition of finalizing the contract (imad al-'aqd) before the Iddah concludes. This interpretation aligns with the juristic consensus that engagement is permissible during the waiting period, provided the marriage is not legally sealed, thereby offering practical guidance for courtship rituals in Shia fiqh.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassanasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:235] but do not give them a promise in secret (during their waiting period) unless you speak to them in a lawful manner and you must not decide to form terms of marriage until the appointed time is complete. Heasws said: ‘The man is saying the place of your date (with me) is the house of so and so family’. He makes advances to her and he is shameless. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying
unless you speak in a goodly manner
, and the goodly words is the introduction with the proposal upon its aspect, and its lawfulness and do not confirm the marriage tie until the writing is fulfilled’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘. . . but you must not secretly date such women (during their waiting period).’ [2:235].

He (the Imam) said, ‘It is his saying, “The place for your date (with me) is the house of the family of so and so where he asks her for rafath (sexual intercourse) and performs it, and Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, says, “Unless you speak in a lawful manner.”

Speaking in a lawful manner is proposing for marriage the way it should be in a lawful manner which is, “You must not decide forming the terms of marriage until the appointed time of waiting period is complete.’””
